read.thesis: Walmart raised FY27 sales guide to 4-5% and EPS to $2.80-2.87 on tariff-refund-funded price investment; Q2 OI growth of 17.4% included ~750bp refund benefit, underlying growth top of 7-10% guide, with supply-side signals (capex ~4% of sales) and no capacity-discipline story.

triggers.label: Rollbacks 7,200 → 11,000
triggers.quote: The Walmart U.S. team delivered more than 11,000 rollbacks during the quarter, up from 7,200 rollbacks at the end of the first quarter

triggers.label: FY27 sales guide raised to 4-5%
triggers.quote: We're raising our fiscal year sales guidance to 4% to 5% from 3.5% to 4.5% previously.
triggers.highlight: raising our fiscal year sales guidance

triggers.label: Q3 OI growth 2-4% cc
triggers.quote: Q3 operating income growth on a constant currency basis is expected to grow 2% to 4%.
